Li W.: quick question — my mom's caregiver just canceled for the week i'm traveling for a product launch. caregiver quote to cover the week is ~$140/day. can company cover emergency/critical?
Rina (People Ops): sorry that happened. eldercare is typically a personal expense, but we do allow emergency/critical coverage in specific situations with preapproval. :heart: older_adult:
Li W.: what counts as emergency/critical?
Rina (People Ops): examples: unexpected caregiver cancellation that would prevent you from attending a mandatory customer or launch activity, or a medical need requiring professional care while you're away. we require manager approval + people-ops signoff before booking.
Samir (manager): @Li W. fwiw i consider the launch mandatory. i'm happy to preapprove pending people-ops review.
Li W.: do i need a note from the caregiver or medical doc?
Rina (People Ops): yes. we need 1) a contemporaneous cancellation note from the provider (screenshot/email) or a physician note if it's medical, 2) a quote/invoice from the replacement caregiver showing dates and rates, 3) your travel confirmation, and 4) manager approval. email people-ops@redwood.com with subject "Eldercare preapproval - [Name] [dates]". we'll respond within 48 business hours.
Li W.: if approved, what do i submit to expense?
Rina (People Ops): submit the paid, itemized invoice (must show provider name, dates, and amount), the people-ops approval email, manager approval note, and travel proof (boarding pass or meeting invite). use expense category "Other - Eldercare (preapproved)".
FinanceBot: finance note: if payment is made to an individual, include a signed receipt with contact details. for non-US caregivers, include transaction proof and currency. payments over $600/year to a single individual may trigger additional paperwork.
Li W.: any dollar limits? $140/day seems within reason for our city but wanted to check.
Rina (People Ops): guideline cap: $150/day for emergency eldercare up to 3 days. exceptions can be made for documented medical necessity or if the event can't be rescheduled; include justification and we'll review case-by-case.
Li W.: what about booking vs retroactive approval? caregiver canceled last night so i already booked replacement. can i request retroactive preapproval?
Rina (People Ops): retroactive requests are accepted for emergencies. include manager approval in your email and the provider cancellation proof. note: approval is not guaranteed retroactively, so try to ping your manager + people-ops before booking when possible.
Samir (manager): i approved this one; Li go ahead and include my note in the email. i trust your judgment.
Li W.: thanks both — i'll send the email and attach the receipts. really appreciate the quick help.
